name: Hyuga Itsuki
source:
"Stop trying to approve of me."

A dancer who dances at 'Dance Trips'.
He was found by the protagonist trying to jump off a building.
He has a loose, undisciplined personality in his private life and with women. He isn't serious about anything.
He's so good at singing it makes peoples hearts tremble, but for some reason he never sings.
He seems to get along with a person named 'Akira'.
